waypoints.name: Hairpin Turn Pullout (Hwy 20)
waypoints.note: The route shares its first 4-5 pitches with Direct East Buttress before breaking left, so it uses the same east-side hairpin/Spire Gully approach.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR 20 (North Cascades Highway) to about half a mile east of Washington Pass and park in the dirt pullout at the obvious hairpin turn, at about 5,100 ft, directly below the east faces of the Early Winters Spires. This is the east-side start, not the Blue Lake trailhead west of the pass.

waypoints.name: South Early Winters Spire
waypoints.directions: Hike up the cairned Spire Gully to the last large tree, traverse right across talus (snow early season) to the gully that leads to the notch between North and South Early Winters Spire, then traverse left to the base of the east buttress before reaching the notch. Climb the shared Direct East Buttress pitches, break out left about halfway up onto the south-facing headwall, and follow its crack pitches to the summit.
